problem.title: "java.io.FileNotFoundException (No such file or directory)"
problem.description: I have a class in my project to upload an image and save in my database and if successful, save it locally. This works and I am able to save the the image in a custom folder I created on my android phone. However, in another class, I'm trying to download an encoded image in text form and save it locally using the method i used above but it doesn't work anymore. It seems I can't create the folder. I don't understand how it worked on my other class and not in this I tried checking my manifest file
